response.sql: WITH vote_ratios AS (SELECT CASE WHEN p.death_country IS NULL OR TRIM(p.death_country) = '' THEN '' ELSE p.death_country END AS country, CAST(v.points_won AS REAL) / v.points_max AS ratio FROM player_award_vote AS v JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE v.points_won IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max <> 0), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio FROM vote_ratios GROUP BY country) SELECT country, average_ratio, average_ratio / AVG(average_ratio) OVER () AS relative_to_country_mean FROM country_averages

assumptions.assumption: “Award-vote record” refers to player_award_vote. NULL and empty death countries form one blank group.

alternatives.interpretation: Include records from both player_award_vote and manager_award_vote.
alternatives.sql: WITH votes AS (SELECT player_id, points_won, points_max FROM player_award_vote UNION ALL SELECT player_id, points_won, points_max FROM manager_award_vote), vote_ratios AS (SELECT CASE WHEN p.death_country IS NULL OR TRIM(p.death_country) = '' THEN '' ELSE p.death_country END AS country, CAST(v.points_won AS REAL) / v.points_max AS ratio FROM votes AS v JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE v.points_won IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max <> 0), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio FROM vote_ratios GROUP BY country) SELECT country, average_ratio, average_ratio / AVG(average_ratio) OVER () AS relative_to_country_mean FROM country_averages
